description: REQ-M3 references '(category, novelty)' tuples for the novelty quota, but the sprint-1 invariant (REQ-H1) and FIND-017 explicitly define the novelty key as '(category, platform)' tuple over applied.jsonl history. '(category, novelty)' is incoherent: 'novelty' is not a column on applied rows, it is the property being computed. Either this is a typo for (category, platform), or sprint-2 silently changes the novelty key. Either way the PROP-M3 test cannot be written correctly until the spec disambiguates.

evidence.snippet: menu.pick_next(menu, log_tail, history) SHALL return the unblocked item with highest roi_estimate × probability_of_landing, applying the novelty quota (REQ-H1 from sprint-1) — at least 10% of picks must be (category, novelty) tuples not seen in history.
